name: Spatio-Temporal Sparse Voxel Octree (STSVO)
definition: A hierarchical data structure for representing the geometry of time-variable 3D scenes by treating the scene as a 4D static space (3 spatial dimensions + 1 time dimension), using a single SVO-like structure instead of a set of separate SVOs for each time frame.
summary: Spatio-Temporal Sparse Voxel Octree is a hierarchical data structure representing time-variable 3D scenes as a single 4D volume, offering 1.73 to 2.08 times greater compactness than separate SVOs.
